user.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers
user.description: Registers the adaptive_lighting_helpers.compute_lighting_groups, compute_curve, compute_scene_coverage, and apply_lighting services - nothing below is required for those. Optionally, fill in these five times to also get day-phase/curve sensors (morning_start, day_start, evening_start, night_start, adaptive_lighting, adaptive_lighting_curve) and a phase-override select, computed the same way, no separate helpers or YAML package needed. Leave them blank to set up just the services. You can add any number of additional named sensors afterwards from this integration's own page.
